lines: France, 1764. Something is hunting in the mountains of Gévaudan.
Shepherds spoke of a beast bigger than any wolf, with a red coat and a dark stripe.
It leapt out of the mist, and vanished before anyone could fight back.
Soon, nobody dared to walk alone.
King Louis the Fifteenth sent his best hunters.
They killed wolf after wolf, but the beast kept coming back.
For three years, it haunted those hills.
In 1767, a local hunter named Jean Chastel shot a huge animal.
Legend says his bullet was made of blessed silver.
Was it a wolf, or something far worse?
title: The Beast That Terrorized France for 3 Years... 🐺 #shorts
description:
From 1764 to 1767, villagers in the mountains of Gévaudan, France, spoke of a huge wolf-like beast. Even the king sent hunters. This is the legend, as people tell it.
